verdict.rationale: Slack's Workflow Builder supports no-code automations triggered by external events (webhook triggers) and conditional branching, and the Events API lets apps react to workspace activity in the background without a user present; AI agents can also read/write Slack Lists directly via the MCP server, enabling autonomous background actions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/time-based triggers, independent hands-on verification that these automations run reliably unattended, and clearer framing of 'AI-native' agent-initiated automations beyond Lists.
